description: Source code for a TypeScript-based REPL service with lazy loading, code evaluation, context setup, and diagnostics handling, used in ts-node environment.

classes.name: EvalState
classes.description: Stores the virtual eval file state including input, output, version, and lines.

methods.name: createRepl
methods.description: Creates a TypeScript REPL instance with lazy-loaded dependencies, context management, and command definitions.

methods.name: createEvalAwarePartialHost
methods.description: Creates a filesystem host that is aware of the virtual eval or REPL files for compilation.

methods.name: setupContext
methods.description: Sets up the execution context with module, filename, and require bindings before eval.
